summary: Skill run-refactor-implementation-acceptance governs deterministic evidence for one explicit execution-plans/<target> refactor; evidence only, never code approval, commit, release, or deploy; require frozen candidate and explicit baseline, complete manifests, typed request, action DAG, command registry, and implementation contract or compact VDD bundle; Quick Dev receipt is authoritative for implementation-complete projection; candidate assembly and inputs are immutable, hash-bound, append-only; create Locator-derived acceptance knowledge context and validate complete read-set, with catalog_stale degraded but non-blocking; prepare typed Skill-input receipt through canonical launcher and require ready validation; start-or-resume binds run-input, contract, context, receipt, and contract hashes, deriving stable run IDs and successor runs on drift; deterministic_only finalizes via replayed controlled receipts and does not invoke Bootstrap; required semantic routes need repository-owned lineage projection, typed route, Bootstrap handoff, high-cost acknowledgement, and exact finalized import; later discovery requires typed trigger, recommendation, confidence, and explicit confirmation; P0/P1 repairs require Quick Dev handoff and completeness audit, with focused verification limits and no Round 4; three consumed rounds lead manual_pause, whose ADR-0054 closure requires protocol review, exact mappings, maintainer acknowledgement, and deterministic finalization; maintenance mode shifts finding severities; historical runs, indexes, calibration, and legacy envelopes are non-authorizing; model launch is restricted to policy-owned recovery triggers; controlled validation permits only registered shell-free commands in isolated roots; missing, stale, ambiguous, unsafe, or schema-invalid artifacts fail closed.
